exposure: GDM diagnosis based on Polish Diabetes Association (PDA) guidelines vs. World Health Organization (WHO) criteria
cohort: 2853 patients with GDM treated in centers nationwide in Poland between 2011 and 2013
finding: The newer Polish Diabetes Association criteria for diagnosing GDM showed greater sensitivity in predicting preterm birth and birth weight compared to the World Health Organization criteria.
birth_weight: Assessed but specific values not provided
